tests.title: Full function across supply voltage range
procedure: 1. Set HIL bench to 23 °C, controller normalized, window fully open.
2. Set supply to 9.0 V. Perform manual close, manual open, express close (short press) and express open; trigger one pinch event in the pinch zone.
3. Repeat step 2 at 12.0 V and 16.0 V.
4. Record that every function works at each voltage.
tests.pass_criteria: At 9.0 V, 12.0 V and 16.0 V all functions (manual, express, anti-pinch, CAN status) operate with no degradation or fault.

tests.title: Low-voltage manual-only mode (6.0 V to 9.0 V)
procedure: 1. Normalized controller, window mid-travel, 23 °C.
2. Set supply to 8.9 V (just below 9.0 V). Short-press (<300 ms) close; observe.
3. Hold switch for manual close and release; observe movement.
4. Repeat steps 2-3 at 7.5 V and 6.0 V.
5. Set supply to 9.0 V and short-press; observe the behavior (express expected as full-function range).
tests.pass_criteria: Between 6.0 V and 9.0 V the window moves only while the switch is held (manual mode) and a short press does not start express mode. Behavior at exactly 9.0 V is recorded; full function per WLC-001 expected. Note: 9.0 V belongs to both WLC-001 and WLC-002 ranges (spec overlap, to be clarified).

tests.title: Motor stop below 6.0 V
procedure: 1. Normalized controller, window moving (manual close) at 12 V, 23 °C.
2. Ramp/step supply down to 5.9 V (just below limit) and capture supply and motor drive on oscilloscope; measure time from crossing below 6.0 V to motor drive off.
3. Repeat with window moving at 6.1 V and reduce to 6.0 V (boundary), noting behavior.
4. Repeat for a step from 12 V to 5.0 V.
tests.pass_criteria: Motor is stopped within 50 ms after supply falls below 6.0 V. At 6.1 V motor continues running (manual mode).

tests.title: Sleep mode quiescent current
procedure: 1. Connect controller to 12 V supply via calibrated µA-capable ammeter, 23 °C.
2. Put controller in sleep (ignition off, no CAN activity, no switch), wait until sleep is entered and current settles.
3. Measure supply current over at least 60 s and record the maximum.
tests.pass_criteria: Maximum sleep current is less than 100 µA at 12 V.

tests.title: Reverse battery withstand
procedure: 1. At 23 °C apply -14 V to supply terminals for 60 s, with current monitoring.
2. Restore correct polarity 12 V.
3. Run a functional check: manual and express movement, CAN WLC_Status, diagnostic request, sleep current.
4. Inspect for visible damage.
tests.pass_criteria: After 60 s at -14 V, controller shows no damage and all functions work as before. Quantitative damage/leakage limit during reverse polarity: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Manual mode movement and stop time
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-travel.
2. Hold close switch for >300 ms (e.g. 1 s) and confirm window moves only while held.
3. Release; measure time from switch release to motor off/position stop. Repeat 10 times for both directions.
tests.pass_criteria: Window moves while the switch is held; motor stops within 100 ms of release in all repetitions.

tests.title: Post-ignition-off movement window
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized. Ignition off at t=0, doors closed.
2. Operate window at t=59 s (just inside); verify movement.
3. Operate window at t=61 s (just outside); verify no movement.
4. New run: ignition off, at t=20 s open a front door; then operate switch at once.
5. New run: open a rear door only (if simulated) at t=20 s; operate switch at t=25 s.
tests.pass_criteria: Movement allowed up to 60 s after ignition off and not after; movement not allowed after a front door opens, whichever occurs first. Rear-door behavior is not specified: observe and record [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Express mode trigger threshold
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized, window mid-travel.
2. Press close switch for 250 ms (inside) and release; observe.
3. Repeat with 299 ms, then 301 ms and 350 ms (just outside).
4. Repeat all in the open direction.
tests.pass_criteria: Presses shorter than 300 ms start express movement in the pressed direction to the end position. Presses longer than 300 ms do not start express (manual behavior). Exact behavior at 300 ms recorded.

tests.title: Express mode stop by second press
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized, start express close from open.
2. During travel press the switch in the close direction; measure time to motor stop.
3. Repeat with press in the open direction.
4. Repeat for express open with both second-press directions.
tests.pass_criteria: In all four cases the window stops within 100 ms of the second press.

tests.title: Full travel time
procedure: 1. Set 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, nominal load.
2. Express close from 480 mm to 0 mm; measure time. Repeat 5 times.
3. Express open for reference.
tests.pass_criteria: Fully-open to fully-closed time is between 3.0 s and 4.5 s in each run.

tests.title: Motor stop at end positions
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized.
2. Express close to 0 mm; monitor motor current/drive.
3. Express open to 480 mm; monitor motor drive.
4. Also hold the switch in manual mode past the end position.
tests.pass_criteria: Motor drive is off once the window reaches the end position (0 mm / 480 mm) in express and manual modes. Time allowed to stop after reaching the end: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: CAN WLC_CloseAll with anti-pinch
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized, window open.
2. Send WLC_CloseAll on CAN with no switch input; observe window.
3. Repeat with an obstacle in the pinch zone producing force above 80 N.
4. Repeat with window mid-travel.
tests.pass_criteria: Window closes in express mode on WLC_CloseAll; with the obstacle, the anti-pinch reaction occurs (stop and reversal per WLC-015).

tests.title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: 1. Normalized, 13.5 V: short-press close and verify express close works.
2. Cause not-normalized state (supply interruption >500 ms), window mid-travel.
3. Short-press close; observe. Also hold switch for manual close.
4. Normalize per WLC-022 and repeat short press.
tests.pass_criteria: Express close is available only when normalized; not available when not normalized (manual close still moves the window).

tests.title: Pinch detection threshold and zone
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Use force-emulating obstacle/HIL pinch-force model.
2. Close with pinch force ramping to 79 N (just below) at 100 mm position; observe no detection.
3. Repeat with force 81 N (just above); observe detection.
4. Repeat force 81 N at positions 4 mm and 200 mm (zone edges) and at 3 mm and 201 mm (outside zone).
5. Repeat at 9 V and 16 V.
tests.pass_criteria: A pinch is detected when force exceeds 80 N while closing within 4 mm to 200 mm; no detection below 80 N. Behavior outside the zone is recorded (no pinch reaction expected). Behavior at exactly 80 N is recorded.

tests.title: Pinch reaction: stop time and reversal distance
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized.
2. Trigger pinch at 100 mm; measure time from detection to motor stop; measure reversal distance.
3. Trigger pinch at 180 mm; same measurements.

4. Trigger pinch at 4 mm and 20 mm; the window can't reverse further than fully open? verify for case where open travel is less than 150 mm: use a position such that fully-open is closer (e.g. a start at 400 mm is outside the zone, so verify by simulation/model review as the zone limits 200 mm).
tests.pass_criteria: Motor stops within 10 ms of pinch detection and the window reverses at least 150 mm or to fully open (480 mm), whichever is less.

tests.title: Anti-pinch active in manual and express; disabled when not normalized
procedure: 1. Normalized, 13.5 V. Close in manual mode, apply >80 N in pinch zone; observe.
2. Repeat in express mode.
3. Make the controller not normalized; close in manual mode with >80 N in the pinch zone; observe.
4. Repeat attempting express (should be unavailable).
tests.pass_criteria: When normalized, pinch reaction occurs in both manual and express modes. When not normalized, no anti-pinch reaction occurs.

tests.title: Express close inhibit after pinch
procedure: 1. Normalized, 13.5 V. Trigger a pinch reversal; mark time t=0 at reversal.
2. Short-press close at 1.9 s (inside inhibit); observe.
3. Repeat run with short-press close at 2.1 s (just outside).
4. Check manual close during the 2 s.
tests.pass_criteria: Express close is inhibited for 2 s after a pinch reversal and available after 2 s. Manual close during the inhibit: observe and record [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Repeated pinch lockout to manual mode
procedure: 1. Normalized, 13.5 V. Trigger three pinches within 30 s (e.g. at 0, 12, 25 s) allowing for the 2 s inhibit.
2. Attempt express close right after, then at 59 s and 61 s after the third pinch; also attempt manual close.
3. Repeat with three pinches spread over 31 s (just outside) and check no lockout.
4. Repeat with only two pinches.
tests.pass_criteria: After three pinch detections within 30 s, closing is allowed only in manual mode for the next 60 s; express close is available after the 60 s. No lockout with only two or with three pinches over more than 30 s.

tests.title: Position resolution
procedure: 1. Feed Hall pulses from a pulse generator/HIL sensor model with known mm-per-pulse relationship.
2. Move window in steps of 0.5 mm equivalent; read position from WLC_Status or a diagnostic read.
3. Compare against reference over full travel 0 to 480 mm.
tests.pass_criteria: Reported position resolves steps of 0.5 mm or better. Accuracy tolerance: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Normalization loss after supply interruption
procedure: 1. Normalized, 13.5 V.
2. Interrupt supply for 400 ms (inside); restore; read normalization state in WLC_Status.
3. Repeat with 499 ms, 501 ms and 600 ms and 2 s.
4. Re-normalize between tests.
tests.pass_criteria: After an interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller reports not normalized. At interruptions below 500 ms, no requirement is placed on state (recorded). Behavior at exactly 500 ms recorded.

tests.title: Normalization procedure
procedure: 1. Start not normalized, 13.5 V.
2. Hold close switch in manual mode until the window is at 0 mm against the seal; hold for 0.9 s then release; check state.
3. Repeat holding for 1.0 s and 1.1 s.
4. Try the same with an express press.
tests.pass_criteria: The controller becomes normalized when the window is held fully closed for 1 s in manual mode; not normalized with a shorter hold (0.9 s).

tests.title: Thermal model existence
procedure: 1. Review software design documentation and code for the motor thermal model.
2. Check inputs (motor current, ambient) and that the estimated temperature is used by the thermal protection functions.
tests.pass_criteria: A thermal model estimating motor temperature is implemented. Accuracy/model limit: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Thermal current limit and blocking with hysteresis
procedure: 1. Normalized, 13.5 V. Inject the estimated motor temperature via HIL (or the thermal model state) at 129 °C; drive and measure motor current.
2. Raise to 131 °C; drive and measure current.
3. Raise to 139 °C: verify opening allowed. Raise to 141 °C: try opening and closing.
4. Lower the temperature to 125 °C (blocking should remain), 121 °C, 119 °C; try opening each time.
tests.pass_criteria: Above 130 °C motor current is limited to 15 A (not below 130 °C). Above 140 °C opening is blocked and closing is allowed. Blocking ends when the estimate falls below 120 °C and remains active between 120 °C and 140 °C.

tests.title: WLC_Status cycle time and content
procedure: 1. Log CAN with timestamps for 10 min at 13.5 V during idle, moving, and fault states.
2. Compute period between consecutive WLC_Status frames.
3. Verify signals: position, movement state, normalization state, fault state against known HIL values.
tests.pass_criteria: All WLC_Status periods are 50 ms ± 5 ms (45 ms to 55 ms); message contains correct position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

tests.title: Hall sensor loss DTC B1A01
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, drive the motor (manual close).
2. Remove Hall pulses; time stamps from loss.
3. Check DTC memory and motor drive at 150 ms (inside) and after 200 ms (beyond, e.g. 250 ms).
4. Repeat with pulses lost for 150 ms and then restored (no DTC), and with the motor not driven.
tests.pass_criteria: B1A01 is stored and the motor stopped when Hall signal is missing longer than 200 ms while the motor is driven; no DTC when missing 200 ms or less, or when the motor is not driven.

tests.title: Overcurrent DTC B1A02, motor stop and fault state
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, motor driven; inject motor current of 24 A for 100 ms (below); check no DTC.
2. Inject 26 A for 40 ms (short); check no DTC.
3. Inject 26 A for 60 ms; read DTC memory, motor drive, and fault state in WLC_Status.
tests.pass_criteria: B1A02 is stored only when current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms; once stored the motor stops and the fault state is set in WLC_Status. Time to stop after the DTC: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: 1. Send 100 diagnostic requests (e.g. read DTC) at 13.5 V in idle and while the window is moving.
2. Measure the time from request to response.
tests.pass_criteria: Every response arrives within 50 ms.

tests.title: Operating temperature range
procedure: 1. Place controller in chamber with motor/load emulation, soak at -40 °C until stable.
2. At 13.5 V run functional checks: manual, express, anti-pinch, CAN status, diagnostics.
3. Repeat at 23 °C and 85 °C.
4. Also check at -41 °C? not required; skip.
tests.pass_criteria: Controller operates (functions work with no fault) at -40 °C, 23 °C and 85 °C. Function specific limits apply as in the corresponding requirements.

tests.title: Wake-up time from sleep
procedure: 1. Put controller in sleep at 13.5 V, 23 °C.
2. Press switch; measure time from the switch edge to wake-up (motor command/CAN activity).
3. Repeat 20 times.
tests.pass_criteria: Controller wakes within 100 ms of the switch press in every repetition.
